title: Tree trimming from a boom lift
lines: Tall tree near a house or a road? A ladder isn't the answer.
From the basket you work stable, harnessed, and reach every branch.
Below, we mark a danger zone, and nobody stands under it.
Branches come down in a controlled way, never thrown from above.
Power lines? Keep your distance or arrange a shutdown.
Ofek At Tal Cranes. Safety first.
